tool.name: generate_website
tool.description:
Generate a website with AI from a project name and description.

Inputs:
- name: the name of the project.
- description: a short description of the project and the website's purpose.

Returns a static preview image of the generated website and a link to claim and edit the site in a website editor outside of this conversation. Websites are hosted by B12 and can only be edited online using the b12.io software suite. To create a separate, additional website, call the tool again.

subtitle.description: The short and catchy subtitle for hero section of the website in less than 5-10 words. It should capture the goal of the website. It should never mention anything about the website color, style or structure.

_published_faq.name: How do I add b12-mcp-server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add b12-mcp-server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.b12.io/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is b12-mcp-server MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, b12-mcp-server scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is b12-mcp-server's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, b12-mcp-server scores 84/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 1 of 1 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the b12-mcp-server MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: b12-mcp-server provides these MCP tools: generate_website.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to b12-mcp-server?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to b12-mcp-server in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
b12-mcp-server does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
b12-mcp-server is developed by B12. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
